preconditions.description: The input consists of three lines containing valid non-negative integer strings l, r, and n.
The integer value of l is less than or equal to the integer value of r.
The length n is between 1 and 2000 inclusive.
The values of l and r are within the specified bounds [1, 10^800].

postconditions.description: The output consists of exactly two lines.
The output string has length exactly n.
The first line (max_count) equals the actual number of modest substrings in the output string.

postconditions.expression: all(count_modest_substrings(s, l_val, r_val) <= max_count for s in all_strings_of_length_n)
postconditions.description: The count of modest substrings in the output string is the maximum possible among all strings of length n.

postconditions.expression: all(s >= result_str for s in all_strings_of_length_n if count_modest_substrings(s, l_val, r_val) == max_count)
postconditions.description: Among all strings of length n achieving the maximum count, the output string is lexicographically smallest.
